messages:
beau: Heads-up: bike lockers by Embarcadero building A are half-submerged. Lost one commuter-grade helmet to the water today. 20m delay for folks rerouting. 
lina: Noooo my spare helmet is in locker 7. Is it salvageable? 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Ferry service normal. Muni: localized slowdowns near Embarcadero due to standing water. Bike locker access may be affected; use street racks farther inland. 
chris: Swapped to a scooter and parked at the temporary rack on Howard. Pro tip: put plastic bags over saddles. 
tess: I left a pair of dry slippers in conference room F for anyone with soaked shoes. Label says "emergency flippers". 
lina: You are an angel. Heading over. 
beau: Also FYI 4th Ave underpass has a trickle that becomes a mini-river if the rain keeps up. Consider alternate path. 
chris: ETA update: storm crews clearing drains near Embarcadero; expect gradual improvement. 
tess: If anyone wants to borrow a poncho and surrender dignity, mine's at reception. 
lina: haha grabbing slippers and poncho. Commute survival kit activated. :+1: 
beau: ok stay safe everyone, and stash electronics high. Will post another update if bike locker status changes.
